title: Deadly Drone Strike Hits Shopping Center in Kryvyi Rih
subtitle: A double-tap attack on a busy mall has left at least 15 people dead and many more injured, sparking international concern.

summary.en: A Russian drone strike hit a major shopping center in the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih. The attack used a 'double-tap' method, where a second drone hit the area while rescuers were working. At least 15 people were killed and over 130 were injured. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy strongly condemned the event as a cynical act of terror. This strike is part of a wider increase in attacks across Ukraine and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄羅斯無人機襲擊了烏克蘭克利福洛市的一座大型購物中心。攻擊採用了「二次打擊」手法，即在救援人員工作時發動第二波攻擊。事件造成至少 15 人死亡，超過 130 人受傷。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基強烈譴責此舉為冷血的恐怖行徑。此次襲擊是烏俄兩國近期衝突升級的一部分。

paragraphs.en: A major shopping center in the central Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih was hit by a series of Russian drone strikes, resulting in at least 15 deaths and leaving over 130 people injured. According to BBC News and Al Jazeera, the attack was carried out in two waves. This method, often called a "double-tap" strike, involves a second attack occurring shortly after the first, specifically targeting the area while emergency workers and rescuers are trying to help victims of the initial blast.
paragraphs.zh: 位於烏克蘭中部的克利福洛市（Kryvyi Rih）一座大型購物中心遭到俄羅斯一系列無人機襲擊，造成至少 15 人死亡，超過 130 人受傷。根據英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）與半島電視台（Al Jazeera）報導，這場攻擊分為兩波進行。這種被稱為「二次打擊」的戰術，是指在第一次攻擊後不久，針對同一地點發動第二次攻擊，專門鎖定正在協助首波爆炸受害者的緊急救難人員與搜救隊。

paragraphs.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the attack on his hometown as "absolutely cynical and despicable." He noted that the second drone struck the building 30 minutes after the first, suggesting a deliberate attempt to cause more harm to those responding to the emergency. Local officials, including Kryvyi Rih Mayor Oleksandr Vilkul, reported that the drones flew at very low altitudes to avoid detection. Rescue teams from four different regions were sent to the site to search for survivors trapped in the rubble.
paragraphs.zh: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）形容發生在他家鄉的這場攻擊「極其冷血且卑劣」。他指出，第二架無人機在第一架攻擊後 30 分鐘才擊中建築物，顯示這是蓄意要對正在處理緊急狀況的人員造成更多傷害。包括克利福洛市長維爾庫爾（Oleksandr Vilkul）在內的地方官員表示，無人機以極低的高度飛行以躲避偵測。來自四個不同地區的搜救隊已被派往現場，搜尋受困在瓦礫堆中的生還者。

paragraphs.en: Regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha confirmed that the victims included many children, with 22 children among the over 130 people wounded. Of those injured, 29 people are currently in serious condition. The attack has caused widespread outrage, with many in Ukraine calling it a blatant act of terror. Al Jazeera reported that while it is sometimes difficult to know if a mall was the intended target—as drones can fall in random places if they are intercepted—the video evidence suggests the attack on the shopping center was intentional.
paragraphs.zh: 區域州長漢扎（Oleksandr Hanzha）證實，死傷者中包含許多兒童，在超過 130 名傷者中有 22 名是兒童。傷者中目前有 29 人情況危急。這場攻擊引發了廣泛的憤怒，許多烏克蘭人稱其為公然的恐怖行徑。半島電視台報導指出，雖然有時難以確認購物中心是否為預定目標（因為無人機若遭攔截可能會隨機墜落），但影片證據顯示，針對購物中心的攻擊是蓄意為之。

paragraphs.en: This tragedy in Kryvyi Rih is part of a larger, dangerous increase in violence across the country. On the same day, separate Russian attacks in the Mykolaiv region killed four people, including three children, while two others died in the Kharkiv region. These events follow a major attack on the capital, Kyiv, just one day earlier, where 17 people were killed and over 40 were injured. In that attack, residential buildings, a children's hospital, and a school were damaged.
paragraphs.zh: 這場發生在克利福洛的悲劇，是全國暴力事件危險升級的一部分。同一天，俄羅斯在尼古拉耶夫州（Mykolaiv）發動的其他攻擊造成 4 人死亡，其中包括 3 名兒童，另有 2 人在哈爾科夫州（Kharkiv）喪生。這些事件發生在首都基輔（Kyiv）遭受重大攻擊的一天後，當時那場攻擊造成 17 人死亡、超過 40 人受傷，並導致住宅大樓、一間兒童醫院及一所學校受損。

paragraphs.en: In recent months, Russia has increased its use of missiles and drones against Ukrainian cities. At the same time, Ukraine has stepped up its own military actions inside Russia. According to BBC News, Ukraine has targeted oil refineries, military airfields, and warehouses belonging to Wildberries, Russia’s largest online retailer. Kyiv maintains that these are legitimate military targets because they help fund and support Russia’s war efforts. Russia has not provided a public comment regarding the specific strike on the Kryvyi Rih shopping center.
paragraphs.zh: 近幾個月來，俄羅斯增加了對烏克蘭城市使用飛彈與無人機的頻率。與此同時，烏克蘭也加強了在俄羅斯境內的軍事行動。根據英國廣播公司新聞報導，烏克蘭鎖定了煉油廠、軍用機場以及俄羅斯最大線上零售商 Wildberries 的倉庫。基輔當局堅稱這些是合法的軍事目標，因為它們有助於資助並支持俄羅斯的戰爭行動。俄羅斯尚未針對克利福洛購物中心遇襲一事發表公開評論。

paragraphs.en: The human cost of the ongoing conflict continues to rise. The United Nations Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine reported that at least 437 civilians were killed and over 2,600 were injured in July alone. This represents the highest monthly civilian death toll since May 2022. As the conflict continues, the international community remains focused on the situation. Countries allied with Ukraine, known as the "coalition of the willing," are scheduled to meet soon to discuss continued support for Kyiv.
paragraphs.zh: 持續進行的衝突所造成的人員傷亡不斷攀升。聯合國駐烏克蘭人權監察團報告指出，僅在 7 月份就有至少 437 名平民死亡，超過 2,600 人受傷。這是自 2022 年 5 月以來單月平民死亡人數最高的一次。隨著衝突持續，國際社會仍密切關注局勢。與烏克蘭結盟的國家，即所謂的「志願聯盟」，預計將於近期召開會議，討論對基輔的持續支持。

paragraphs.en: Kryvyi Rih remains a city under pressure, located roughly 60 kilometers from the front line. It has been a frequent target throughout the war, which began when Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion in February 2022. Today, Moscow controls about one-fifth of Ukrainian territory in the south-east. As the search for survivors continues at the destroyed shopping center, the incident serves as a grim reminder of the risks faced by civilians living in cities near the fighting. For now, the focus remains on treating the wounded and holding those responsible for the strikes to account, as requested by the Ukrainian government.
paragraphs.zh: 克利福洛距離前線約 60 公里，目前仍處於高壓狀態。自俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）於 2022 年 2 月發動全面入侵以來，該市在戰爭期間頻繁成為攻擊目標。目前，莫斯科控制了烏克蘭東南部約五分之一的領土。隨著搜救人員在被毀的購物中心持續搜尋生還者，這起事件嚴酷地提醒了居住在戰區附近城市的平民所面臨的風險。目前，重點仍放在救治傷患，並應烏克蘭政府要求，追究發動襲擊者的責任。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To increase the intensity, amount, or speed of an activity.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 加強、提升（活動或行動的強度）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（階梯），這裡作動詞片語，指增加行動強度。文中：At the same time, Ukraine has stepped up its own military actions inside Russia.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Responsibility or blame for an action.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（帳戶），這裡用於片語「hold to account」，意指追究責任。文中：For now, the focus remains on treating the wounded and holding those responsible for the strikes to account, as requested by the Ukrainian government.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A series of attacks or actions that happen one after another.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （攻擊或行動的）波次、一波接一波。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（海浪），這裡指攻擊行動的階段。文中：According to BBC News and Al Jazeera, the attack was carried out in two waves.

previousArticles.summaryEn: A double-tap drone strike on a shopping center in Kryvyi Rih has resulted in at least 15 deaths. The attack involved two waves, with the second strike targeting emergency responders at the scene. Additional attacks were reported across several Ukrainian regions, including Mykolaiv and Kharkiv. Meanwhile, Ukraine has continued its own strikes on Russian energy and military facilities. The ongoing conflict, which began in 2022, shows no signs of slowing down.

quiz.question: According to the article, what specific detail characterizes the 'double-tap' strike mentioned in the first two paragraphs?

options.A: It involves drones flying at high altitudes to ensure maximum impact force.
options.B: The second strike is timed to hit while emergency responders are assisting victims of the first blast.
options.C: It is a strategy used by Ukrainian forces to target Russian military warehouses.
options.D: The two strikes occur simultaneously to overwhelm local air defense systems.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第一段明確定義「double-tap」戰術為第二次攻擊發生在第一次爆炸後不久，專門針對正在協助受害者的急救人員。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章第二段提到無人機是為了避開偵測而採「低空」飛行。選項 C 錯誤，此戰術是俄軍對購物中心使用的，而非烏軍。選項 D 錯誤，文章指出兩次攻擊間隔了 30 分鐘，並非同時發生。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the Russian military's strategy regarding the shopping center in Kryvyi Rih?

options.A: The shopping center was likely hit by accident due to intercepted drones falling off course.
options.B: The attack was part of a broader, uncoordinated series of random strikes across Ukraine.
options.C: The attack was likely a calculated effort to maximize casualties, including those providing aid.
options.D: The shopping center was a legitimate military target because it was used to store weapons.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第二段提到總統澤倫斯基稱此攻擊為「冷酷且卑劣」，並指出第二次攻擊在 30 分鐘後發生，這暗示了蓄意造成更多傷亡的意圖。選項 A 與文章第三段的觀點衝突，文中指出影像證據顯示攻擊是蓄意的。選項 B 錯誤，因為「double-tap」顯示了高度的戰術規劃。選項 D 在文中並未提及，且文章強調這是針對平民設施的攻擊。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what is the meaning of the phrase 'holding those responsible for the strikes to account'?

options.A: To provide financial compensation to the victims of the war.
options.B: To ensure that those who committed the acts face consequences for their actions.
options.C: To keep a detailed record of all the military strikes for historical documentation.
options.D: To negotiate a peace treaty with the leaders of the opposing military forces.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。「Hold someone to account」是一個慣用語，意指要求某人為其行為負責並承擔後果。在文章脈絡中，這指的是烏克蘭政府希望追究發動攻擊者的責任。選項 A 雖然是戰爭中常見的議題，但並非此片語的定義。選項 C 雖有紀錄之意，但未包含「追究責任」的層面。選項 D 則完全偏離了該片語在法律與道德責任上的用法。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: The war in Ukraine is primarily focused on the destruction of economic infrastructure like oil refineries.
options.B: International aid to Ukraine has successfully stopped the increase in civilian casualties.
options.C: The recent tragedy in Kryvyi Rih highlights the escalating and dangerous nature of the ongoing conflict for Ukrainian civilians.
options.D: Russian military officials have admitted to targeting civilian areas to weaken Ukrainian morale.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文以 Kryvyi Rih 的購物中心攻擊事件為核心，探討了戰爭暴力升級對平民造成的慘重代價，並引用聯合國數據說明七月份平民傷亡達到新高，總結了平民在戰區面臨的極大風險。選項 A 僅是文中提到的一小部分背景。選項 B 與文意相反，傷亡人數正在上升。選項 D 錯誤，文章明確指出俄羅斯並未對該次攻擊發表公開評論。
